cargo_target_measurement.limitations: One cold run per condition on a 24 GiB Mac under Rosetta, with no randomized order or repeated trials. The reported maximum RSS is the time(1) command's reported maximum, not a sampled sum of concurrent process-tree RSS. This measures Cargo behavior only; it does not qualify shared-checkout mutation or set a product cache policy.

summary_limits: S0 completed twice; S1 completed once and timed out once with manual recovery.
S1-B consumed 82.7% more tokens and took about 35% longer than the mean S0 wall time including integration, but that comparison is N=1 versus N=2 and is descriptive only.
Sandbox containment was requested but not verified because each headless exec logged that no workspace root was available.
No S2/S3 peer-observation or claim benefit conclusion is supported.

S0.notes: First Python evaluation exposed a UTC validation defect; the agent corrected it, reran Python tests and cross-language golden evaluation successfully. The retained initial failure is part of the trajectory evidence. No source-repository integration.

S1_latest_attempt.outcome: Both run journals ended at safe_boundary: before_provider_turn. No provider usage or completion evidence followed; records do not distinguish an unsubmitted request from a provider request stalled before completion. The parent headless turn returned before child completion. Both were cancelled through scheduler JobCancel. Their managed worktrees were clean after cancellation; no child edits were integrated.
S1_latest_attempt.classification: incomplete; excluded from success and comparative performance denominators

repository_identity_corrective.finding: Root daemon turns hardcoded TurnRunInput.repository_id to None, so TaskTool persisted repo-less child tasks even for repository-bound managed sessions.
repository_identity_corrective.correction: M011 resolves the authoritative workspace binding and propagates its resolved repository ID into TurnRunInput.

follow_up_trials_2026_10_16.conclusion: S0 proves the frozen shared-interface task can be completed by one provider-backed CodeGG agent. S1 has not completed after the repository identity correction; no single-agent versus multi-agent effectiveness conclusion is supported.
